scope_config.selection: Provisional pixel scope, chosen before scoped scores; not a proven detectability limit or a tuned acceptance threshold.
scope_config.distance_policy: No guessed metric distance cutoff; use source-image box size consistently across models.
scope_config.prediction_policy: Match main GT first. Only unmatched predictions mostly within ignored GT can be ignored; do not globally drop small predictions.
scope_config.training_policy: Preserve all original GT. Evaluation ignore is not a YOLO TXT training ignore flag. Do not delete tiny positive labels or convert tiny-only images into negatives.
